テキスト cha 459: Serving the imperial family, the Prince above all, she flees east with them and later settles in the Arata settlement. When the Prince fled the Tara clan he dropped his dagger; Ito picked it up, and so came along. Her family served the imperial family and had some standing, but fell into decline in her grandparents' day; though allowed to serve, she was born to low rank. As of Shiyo 800 she has lived over 800 years, yet looks every bit a teenage girl.

Like the third generation, she has one green eye, but this is unrelated to Shigatsu Youka or Droga: it is a pure mutation. The third generation's eye color is thought to come from hers.\n　　In the capital she seldom appeared in public, so her eyes caused no stir, and as she was born with them, those around her treated them as normal. But outsiders who saw her were startled, and some apparently even tried to kidnap Ito by exploiting the Prince's decree.

In Shiyo 6 she nearly dies in an accident but survives when Shigatsu Youka parasitizes her; in exchange for her life, she gives it intellect. At first it had none, reproducing only through Droga-infected creatures. Gaining human intellect, it began planning more efficient reproduction, taking in human after human to grow smarter. So it puts the dead to work, steers human society with what passes for danger sense, and sets its sights on the land of Motoki.

The person dear to Ito apparently sleeps beneath Motoki-cho, and she originally meant to bring that person back to life with Shigatsu Youka's power. But it turns out that even Shigatsu Youka's power cannot revive a skeleton. This raises the question of whether Ito was merely being used.

Until now a mad side of her showed, but it came from a purpose that was pure in its own way, and when Natsumi Kogori offers another way, she realizes she can still achieve her purpose. Just before she is taken back into Shigatsu Youka, she is shown touched by Natsumi's kindness, as if she has had a change of heart, but now that it has come to this, she can surely never return to being human.

Out of a pure wish to be at the Prince's side, she vowed to wait for his return forever. That wish never came true: Ito was mortally wounded, taken in by Shigatsu Youka, and lives on almost forever. But since the Prince died in the land of Motoki soon after parting from Ito, she now schemes to move to Motoki-cho to revive him.

Pressed by Natsumi Kogori, "Do you want Nii-sama to see you like this?", she realizes all she has done was wrong. To show no more disgrace and folly, she asks to be destroyed along with Shigatsu Youka. With the settlement's help, Shigatsu Youka vanishes on contact with much third-generation blood, and Ito, losing its protection, dies too. Telling Natsumi, "I would have liked to go to Motoki-cho," she promises to go there if reborn, and crumbles away.
